items.before: Before, an amended notification's tag read 'Amending' and only the review page offered a 'Cancel amendment' link. Now the overview and every question page show the 'Amend' tag, the reference and a 'Cancel amend' link above the heading, which opens the cancel amendment confirmation page. Drafts show 'Draft' with no Cancel amend. Plants makes the same change, in English and Welsh.
items.after:
Before:

- an amended notification's tag read 'Amending'
- only the review page offered a 'Cancel amendment' link

Now the overview and every question page show these above the heading:

- the 'Amend' tag
- the reference
- a 'Cancel amend' link, which opens the cancel amendment confirmation page

Drafts show 'Draft', with no 'Cancel amend'.

Plants makes the same change, in English and Welsh.

items.before: An amendment shows an 'Amend' status bar with Cancel amend on the overview, the review and every question page, in every set that amends
items.after: An amendment shows an 'Amend' status bar with 'Cancel amend'. It appears on the overview, the review and every question page, in every set that amends.

items.before: Before, during an amendment a page opened from a Change link saved straight back to the notification view. Now each page the overview links to ends with 'Save and return' (back to the amend review), 'Save and continue' (on to the next page) and a link-styled 'Save and return to overview', with no cancel link. The address pickers, the CPH number page and the permanent address page show only the first two. Back links stay as they are in the journey. Plants pages and pickers get the same buttons.
items.after:
Before, during an amendment, a page opened from a Change link saved straight back to the notification view.

Now each page the overview links to ends with:

- 'Save and return', which goes back to the amend review
- 'Save and continue', which goes on to the next page
- a link-styled 'Save and return to overview'

There is no cancel link.

The address pickers, the CPH number page and the permanent address page show only the first two.

Back links stay as they are in the journey.

Plants pages and pickers get the same buttons.

items.before: During an amendment, pages end with Save and return, Save and continue and Save and return to overview, and Continue on the amend review is held while anything is incomplete, in animals and plants
items.after: During an amendment, pages end with 'Save and return', 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview'. 'Continue' on the amend review is held while anything is incomplete. Both apply in animals and plants.

items.before: An amendment's review now opens with no errors showing and is headed 'Review your notification'; once an answer differs from what was submitted, it becomes 'Review before re-submitting'. It ends with Continue, a 'Cancel amend' button and a red 'Delete', replacing the 'Cancel amendment' link under the heading. Continue on an unfinished amendment does not submit it: the review shows again, naming what is missing. Plants makes the same change, except that its heading does not yet change when answers change.
items.after:
An amendment's review now opens with no errors showing.

It is headed 'Review your notification'. Once an answer differs from what was submitted, the heading becomes 'Review before re-submitting'.

The review ends with:

- Continue
- a 'Cancel amend' button
- a red 'Delete'

This ending replaces the 'Cancel amendment' link under the heading.

Continue on an unfinished amendment does not submit it. The review shows again, naming what is missing.

Plants makes the same change, with one exception: its heading does not yet change when answers change.

items.before: Review ends with Continue and Delete, and an amendment's review offers Cancel amend and tells the trader they are re-submitting
items.after: The review ends with 'Continue' and 'Delete'. An amendment's review also offers 'Cancel amend' and tells the trader they are re-submitting.

items.before: During an amendment, pages end with Save and return, Save and continue and Save and return to overview, and Continue on the amend review is held while anything is incomplete, in animals and plants
items.after: During an amendment, pages end with 'Save and return', 'Save and continue' and 'Save and return to overview'. 'Continue' on the amend review is held while anything is incomplete. Both apply in animals and plants.
